title: bheka.risk.recalculated.v1
description: Emitted by bheka-policy when it appends a new risk_scores row after recalculating a user's risk. Stream: DETECTION. Consumers: bheka-console (dashboards), bheka-notify (threshold-crossing alerts). Per-subject-user-id ordering preferred but not guaranteed; consumers must derive ordering from occurred_at (010_EVENT_BUS_AND_TOPICS section 2).

event_id.description: UUIDv7. De-duplicate consumers on this field.

occurred_at.description: ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC at which bheka-policy completed the recalculation.

risk_score_id.description: UUIDv7 of the new risk_scores row. Each row is immutable (no updated_at) — every recalculation creates a new row.

user_id.description: UUIDv7 of the users row for the scored data subject.

score.description: Normalised risk score 0-100. Never a black box — contributing_signals below provides the decomposition (CANON section 5, refusal 6: no opaque scoring).

detection_id.description: UUIDv7 of the detections row that contributed to this score.

weight.description: Fractional contribution of this signal to the total score.

reason.description: Human-readable explanation of why this signal contributed at this weight.

contributing_signals.description: Explainable decomposition of the score. Required by CANON section 5 (no opaque scoring). Mirrors risk_scores.contributing_signals in PostgreSQL.
